bau.name: Scenario #1 · Business as usual
bau.narrative: Current trends continue, gradual change in the energy mix. Weather like today, renewables keep growing at today's pace, neighbours similar, import/export/transit as in 2022-2026, border capacity unchanged.

transition.name: Scenario #2 · Successful energy transition
transition.narrative: Countries reach their targets: high renewable penetration and enough flexibility. Renewables at their peak can drive prices down (negative prices); storage, e-mobility and electrified demand grow.

delayed.name: Scenario #3 · Delayed energy transition
delayed.narrative: Targets are missed and winters depend on gas plants. Very hot summers and cold winters raise cooling and heating demand, nuclear declines, dry summers drain hydro, PV becomes the main option; export capacity is limited.

backtest.note: LightGBM sees the actual fundamentals of each hour (an 'ex-post' fundamental fit, like a PFC shape model), the naive models only see past prices.

fuel.source: TTF day-ahead (EEX) and EU ETS EUA, data/csv
